+/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
+ * CodeMirror Global History View
+ * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
+const globalHistoryRequest = StateEffect.define();
+const fsCreateFile = StateEffect.define();
+const fsDeleteFile = StateEffect.define();
+
+const fsInvertedEffects = invertedEffects.of((tr) => {
+  const found = [];
+  for (const e of tr.effects) {
+    if (e.is(fsCreateFile)) found.push(fsDeleteFile.of({ name: e.value.name, text: e.value.text }));
+    if (e.is(fsDeleteFile)) found.push(fsCreateFile.of({ name: e.value.name, text: e.value.text }));
+  }
+  return found;
+});
+
+class HistoryView {
+  constructor() {
+    this.targetView = null;
+    this.invalidGlobalRedoDepth = 0;
+    
+    this.editor = new EditorView({
+      state: EditorState.create({
+        extensions: [
+          history(),
+          fsInvertedEffects,
+          EditorView.updateListener.of((update) => {
+            let changed = false;
+            for (const tr of update.transactions) {
+              // Ignore forwarding redo/undo loops
+              if (tr.isUserEvent('undo') || tr.isUserEvent('redo')) continue;
+              
+              // Apply file changes
+              for (const e of tr.effects) {
+                if (e.is(fsCreateFile)) {
+                  state.files.set(e.value.name, { name: e.value.name, binary: false, text: e.value.text });
+                  state.archive.delete(e.value.name);
+                  state.active = e.value.name; // Focus the file
+                  changed = true;
+                } else if (e.is(fsDeleteFile)) {
+                  const f = state.files.get(e.value.name);
+                  if (f) {
+                    let archiveName = f.name;
+                    let c = 1;
+                    while (state.archive.has(archiveName)) {
+                      const parts = f.name.split(".");
+                      if (parts.length > 1) {
+                        const ext = parts.pop();
+                        archiveName = parts.join(".") + ` (${c++}).` + ext;
+                      } else {
+                        archiveName = `${f.name} (${c++})`;
+                      }
+                    }
+                    state.archive.set(archiveName, { ...f, archiveName, originalName: f.name, text: e.value.text });
+                  }
+                  state.files.delete(e.value.name);
+                  if (state.active === e.value.name) state.active = "main.lua";
+                  changed = true;
+                }
+              }
+
+              // Forward pointers to targetView
+              if (this.targetView && tr.effects.some(e => e.is(fsCreateFile) || e.is(fsDeleteFile))) {
+                this.targetView.dispatch({
+                  effects: [globalHistoryRequest.of({ request: 'redo' })],
+                  annotations: [isolateHistory.of('full')]
+                });
+              }
+            }
+            if (changed) { renderTabs(); selectFile(state.active); }
+          })
+        ]
+      })
+    });
+  }
+
+  getLocalExtension() {
+    return [
+      history(),
+      EditorView.updateListener.of((update) => {
+        for (const transaction of update.transactions) {
+          if (!transaction.docChanged || transaction.isUserEvent('undo') || transaction.isUserEvent('redo') || 
+              transaction.effects.some(e => e.is(globalHistoryRequest))) continue;
+          
+          const invalidRedoDepth = redoDepth(this.editor.state);
+          if (this.invalidGlobalRedoDepth !== invalidRedoDepth) {
+            this.invalidGlobalRedoDepth = invalidRedoDepth;
+          }
+        }
+      }),
+      EditorView.updateListener.of((vu) => {
+        for (const tr of vu.transactions) {
+          for (const e of tr.effects) {
+            if (e.is(globalHistoryRequest)) {
+              if (e.value.request === 'undo') undo(this.editor);
+              else {
+                if (Math.max(0, redoDepth(this.editor.state) - this.invalidGlobalRedoDepth) > 0) redo(this.editor);
+              }
+            }
+          }
+        }
+      }),
+      invertedEffects.of((tr) => {
+        const found = [];
+        for (const e of tr.effects) {
+          if (e.is(globalHistoryRequest)) {
+            found.push(globalHistoryRequest.of({ request: e.value.request === 'undo' ? 'redo' : 'undo' }));
+          }
+        }
+        return found;
+      })
+    ];
+  }
+
+  registerTarget(view) {
+    this.targetView = view;
+  }
+
+  dispatchGlobalEvent(effect) {
+    this.editor.dispatch({ effects: [effect] });
+  }
+
+  createFile(name, text) {
+    this.dispatchGlobalEvent(fsCreateFile.of({ name, text }));
+  }
+
+  deleteFile(name, text) {
+    this.dispatchGlobalEvent(fsDeleteFile.of({ name, text }));
+  }
+
+  undo(localTarget) {
+    if (!undo(localTarget)) undo(this.editor);
+  }
+  
+  redo(localTarget) {
+    if (!redo(localTarget)) {
+      if (Math.max(0, redoDepth(this.editor.state) - this.invalidGlobalRedoDepth) > 0) redo(this.editor);
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+window.globalHistory = new HistoryView();

+        local bx, by = width / 2 - bw / 2, height / 2
+        
+        local hover = mx > bx and mx < bx + bw and my > by and my < by + bh
+        if hover then
+            love.graphics.setColor(0.4, 0.4, 0.4)
+        else
+            love.graphics.setColor(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
+        end
+        love.graphics.rectangle("fill", bx, by, bw, bh, 5)
+        
+        love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
+        love.graphics.printf("View Documentation", bx, by + 12, bw, "center")
+        
+    elseif state == "api_list" then
+        love.graphics.setColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
+        love.graphics.print("LÖVE API Modules (Click to view, ESC to go back)", 20, 20)
+        
+        local mx, my = love.mouse.getPosition()
+        
+        for i, m in ipairs(modules) do
+            local y = 60 + (i - 1) * 35 + scroll
+            local bx, by, bw, bh = 20, y, 300, 30
+            
+            if my > 60 and my < height - 20 then
+                if mx > bx and mx < bx + bw and my > by and my < by + bh then
+                    love.graphics.setColor(0.4, 0.4, 0.4)
+                else
+                    love.graphics.setColor(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
+                end
+                love.graphics.rectangle("fill", bx, by, bw, bh, 4)
+                
+                love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
+                love.graphics.print(m.name, bx + 10, by + 8)
+            end
+        end
+        
+    elseif state == "api_detail" then
+        love.graphics.setColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
+        love.graphics.print("Module: " .. selected_module.name .. " (ESC to go back)", 20, 20)
+        
+        local y = 60 + scroll
+        local wrap_limit = width - 40
+        
+        love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
+        local _, wrapped_desc = font:getWrap(selected_module.description or "No description.", wrap_limit)
+        for _, line in ipairs(wrapped_desc) do
+            love.graphics.print(line, 20, y)
+            y = y + 20
+        end
+        y = y + 20
+        
+        if selected_module.functions then
+            love.graphics.setColor(0.5, 0.8, 0.5)
+            love.graphics.print("Functions:", 20, y)
+            y = y + 25
+            
+            for i, f in ipairs(selected_module.functions) do
+                if y > 20 and y < height + 100 then -- Simple culling
+                    love.graphics.setColor(0.4, 0.7, 1)
+                    love.graphics.print(f.name, 20, y)
+                    y = y + 20
+                    
+                    love.graphics.setColor(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
+                    local _, wrapped = font:getWrap(f.description or "", wrap_limit)
+                    for _, line in ipairs(wrapped) do
+                        love.graphics.print(line, 40, y)
+                        y = y + 16
+                    end
+                    y = y + 10
+                else
+                    -- Still need to calculate height if culled so scroll height is correct
+                    y = y + 20
+                    local _, wrapped = font:getWrap(f.description or "", wrap_limit)
+                    y = y + 16 * #wrapped + 10
+                end
+            end
+        else
+            love.graphics.print("No functions documented.", 20, y)
+        end
+    end
 end
